tourLead: Plan the work in chat and follow each task on the board, even when a new agent takes over.
tourTeamBody: Tell the lead what you want to accomplish in your assistant’s chat. Ask them to put together a team for that goal.
tourWorkersBody: Give each agent a role. One worker might research a topic while another drafts a proposal or puts it into practice.
tourBoardBody: Bring the team’s tasks together on a board. The columns show where each task stands and what needs your attention.
tourTaskBody: Choose a worker and describe what you want them to deliver. Add the references and decisions they’ll need to get started.
tourHandoffBody: The worker records what they did and what’s still open. The next agent can pick up the same task and see where to continue.
tourChat: Create a team to look after Bee Team installation.
tourTaskName: Fix copying the request on mobile
tourFinding: Copying fails when the browser blocks clipboard access.
installCopyHint: Copy this request and paste it into your assistant’s chat:
homeTitle: Your next step starts with a conversation.
homeIntroduction: Use your AI assistant to plan with a team lead. This panel brings together the work, context and evidence recorded by your team.
homeTeamTitle: Choose your team with a team lead
homeTeamBody: A team lead coordinates the work. Workers carry out assigned tasks and record their results. Start by reviewing the teams already available in your local application.
homeLeaderPrompt: Use get-a-team-lead to show me the existing teams and guide me through the first steps.
homeCopyFailed: Select the prompt above and copy it manually.
homePlanTitle: Agree on the goal and the plan
homePlanBody: Discuss the objective, scope and expected result with your team lead. Boards organize tasks; each task can hold a specification, plans, conversation and files.
homeFollowTitle: Follow progress and resume with context
homeFollowBody: Workers record progress, summaries and pending work. After a task is assigned, get-a-worker guides its execution. Read the recorded evidence in the panel and continue decisions in your conversation with the team lead.
connectionReady: Your local application is connected and compatible.
launchEyebrow: A shared workspace for AI agents
launchLead: Keep each task’s plan, decisions and next steps together. When another agent takes over, it can pick up where the first one left off.
launchLocalOpen: Your work history stays on your computer.
launchProductCaption: A sample team working through a product release.
launchWorkflowTitle: The next agent knows where to start.
launchWorkflowBody: One agent investigates the problem and records its findings. Another opens the same task, reads the summary and picks up from there.
launchTeamBenefit: See who owns each task and how the team is organized.
launchEvidenceBenefit: Read plans, decisions, files and progress together.
launchContextBenefit: Resume work with the context already recorded.
launchInstallBody: Choose your assistant, copy the request and paste it into its chat.
launchNodeHelp: The command uses npx. If Node.js is not available, install it first or follow the manual instructions.
launchProjectScope: Run this command in your project. It copies the skills into that project's harness directory.
launchAskSetup: Then tell your assistant: Use setup-bee-team to install and start Bee Team.
launchManualHarness: Use the manual instructions to copy the skills into your harness's supported directory.
